Tracks

Core Track

Agentic Web

Core Track: Build autonomous AI agents that can act, transact, and
coordinate using Sui’s object model and composability.

3rd place prize sponsor:

Core Track

DeFi & Payments

Core Track: Create financial primitives or payment rails on Sui that
are fast, seamless, and usable in real-world scenarios.

1st place prize sponsor:

3rd place prize sponsor:

Specialized Track

Walrus

Specialized Track: Leverage Walrus to build applications that
handle large, off-chain, or verifiable data.

Track sponsor:

Specialized Track

DeepBook

Specialized Track: Build trading or liquidity applications powered
by DeepBook’s on-chain orderbook.

Core Track

Infra & DevX

Core Track: Improve the builder experience: tooling, SDKs, indexers, and infrastructure that make Sui easier to build on.

4th place prize sponsor:
Specialized Track

EVE

Develop fundamental payment rails to power the decentralized web and related applications on Sui.

Specialized Track

ONE Championship

Create a consumer-facing app in gaming, NFTs, sports, media, and more.

Degen

Dogs, cats, and aquatic animals–get creative with anything related to memes and viral degen culture.

FAQ

Sui Overflow 2026 is a global online hackathon where developers and builders create projects on Sui across focused tracks.

Itʼs an opportunity to build alongside a global community, explore new ideas, and gain recognition through prizes and ecosystem support.

Pre-registration is now open. Sign up to receive updates, early access, and next steps as the hackathon approaches.

Anyone is welcome to participate in Sui Overflow 2026! Whether you're a seasoned Web3 developer, a designer, or just starting to explore blockchain, youʼre welcome to join. There are no experience requirements - just bring your ideas and motivation.

You must select the one track that best represents your project.

Yes. Each track will have dedicated mentors and workshops. Stay tuned for updates.

There are many developer resources available to help you get started with Sui and Move. Access the Sui developer docs, explore developer tools and resources on the Sui developer portal, or take a self-paced intro course to Move to get started.

If you have additional questions, please contact devrel@sui.io or @suidevelopers
